# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.119.0.js` is the unmodified UMD browser distribution served by
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0` on 2026-11-15.
This pins the version that the former floating `@2` CDN URL returned during the incident.

- SHA-256: `71e670ca67ad5df7fe3d919f119f30267b44df80df27ac3ac63254a0ba2319df`
- Size: 220148 bytes
- License: MIT, see `supabase-LICENSE.txt` from the same package.

The app loads this file from its own origin before `app.js`. Its versioned filename
is immutable; upgrades must use a new filename and update the loader, public asset
allowlist, size inventory, headers and transport smoke checksum together.
